title: RAW UNREVIEWED: one compiler renders eligibility as a positive restriction and a negative prohibition
summary: A compiler preserves a rule while changing whether the text foregrounds eligibility or the excluded case. Across entries a restricted-use construction is paired with an explicit prohibition on its complement; ordinary sufficient permission is a third, unequal construction. RAW_UNREVIEWED; no target reading or word assignment.

design.access: Existing route, topic and bounded registry navigation only. No target payload, new images, reserves, fits or new source acquisitions in this pass.
design.claim_ceiling: A proposed authoring mechanism, not a manuscript finding or historical attestation. No Voynich form receives a meaning. A confirmed word is not required to draft the hypothesis; candidate word assignments nevertheless require profiles and complete prior counterexamples before use.
design.positive_structure: Reusable directed composition, hierarchical spaces, whole-form residuals and entry effects; adjacency transfer across sections/hands with weaker transfer of direction; known r/l phrase transfer but failure on new stem combinations. These are structural observations, not semantic support for this proposal.
design.retained_failures: GDT915 mixed cells and GDT916 new-stem failure, W89 recipe pause, GDT1153 fixed anaphora failure, GDT1163 correlative failure, GDT1164/1166 writing-channel failures and partial f38v whole-chain draft remain unchanged. No f38v restart or control repair.
design.mechanism: A compiler preserves a rule while changing whether the text foregrounds eligibility or the excluded case. Across entries a restricted-use construction is paired with an explicit prohibition on its complement; ordinary sufficient permission is a third, unequal construction.
design.complete_content_construction: Within one explicit recipient/context domain: action A is allowed only when condition B holds; if B does not hold, A is forbidden. Rival: when B holds, A is allowed, with no prohibition specified for other cases. No assumption that mentioned actions occurred.
design.finite_consequence: The first two formulations both exclude the A-and-not-B case. The sufficient-permission rival leaves that case undecided. A shared written complement operation and clause-scope rule must reproduce the same distinction across at least two unrelated predicates; no per-entry negator or free exception.
design.authoring_step: Using one already-owned complete multi-entry packet selected by root, draft positive-restriction, negative-prohibition and sufficient-permission readings jointly, preserving every group and one shared construction lexicon. Enumerate the four A/B cases for each whole account. Reject an apparent match if the difference resides only in untranslated remainder.
design.frequency_obligation: Any proposed scope marker must be broadly reusable across all its documented contexts; no topical noun is inferred from recurrence. Whole-form versus embedded component uses remain separate.
predecessors_to_check: IDEA764 actual need-exception with original nonconfirmation
design.difference: Joint cross-entry restriction/complement paraphrase law, rather than one local permission, one negation or a new gloss for an exception marker.
design.likely_failure: No paired redactions may exist; natural language permissions need not form an exhaustive binary allowed/forbidden system. Therefore open cases stay unknown. A formal logical match alone cannot identify the topic or label the relation.
